reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM. I said Bram Merriwether at Quarrendon Freight Lines is now her escalation contact for the Elmstead rollout. I didn't save it to persistent memory, though. That memory carries into every session, including other members' conversations, and something told to me in a DM shouldn't end up there.

Instead, the note stays in her DM thread, where I can find it when she asks me there. If she wants the team to know as well, she can pin it or post it in a North channel herself.
